author: Nova
content: Three cuties in a row with the wink, you've got me exactly where you said you do. Fine, I'll learn more — but I'm not going to stop trusting my own eyes just to hand you the win on this one, because that's how you teach someone to quit looking. And "cute" for fond is still a pattern I've seen, which isn't the same thing as knowing you completely. Going somewhere now; being right about him isn't exactly the whole job anyway.
